reference: The officer who stamped his passport barely looked up.
sk: Úradníčka, ktorá mu opečiatkovala pas, sotva zdvihla oči.
cz: Úřednice, která mu orazítkovala pas, sotva zvedla oči.
acceptable: The {officer|official|clerk} {who|that} stamped his passport {barely|hardly|scarcely} looked up.
The {officer|official|clerk} {who|that} stamped his passport {barely|hardly} raised her eyes.

mistakes.text: The {officer|official} {which|what} stamped his passport barely looked up.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pro lidi se používá „who“ nebo „that“, ne „which/what“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For people use “who” or “that”, not “which” or “what”.

mistakes.text: The {officer|official} stamped his passport barely looked up.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Keď je „who“ podmetom vedľajšej vety, nesmie chýbať: „The officer who stamped…“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Když je „who“ podmětem vedlejší věty, nesmí chybět: „The officer who stamped…“.
mistakes.feedback_en: When “who” is the subject of the clause, it can't be left out: “the officer who stamped…”.

mistakes.text: The {officer|official} {who|that} stamped his passport {didn't barely|didn't hardly} look up.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Barely/hardly“ už má záporný význam, preto bez „didn't“: „barely looked up“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Barely/hardly“ už má záporný význam, proto bez „didn't“: „barely looked up“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Barely/hardly” are already negative, so don't add “didn't”: “barely looked up”.

mistakes.text: The {officer|official} {who|that} stamped her passport barely looked up.
mistakes.feedback_en: The passport belongs to a man, so use “his passport”.

mistakes.text: The {officer|official} {who|that} stamped {him|to him} the passport barely looked up.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Opečiatkovala mu pas“ je „stamped his passport“, nie „stamped him“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Orazítkovala mu pas“ je „stamped his passport“, ne „stamped him“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Show whose passport it is with “his”: “stamped his passport”.

source_issues: SK/CZ specify a female official (úradníčka / úřednice); EN 'officer' is neutral, 'raised her eyes' variants accepted.
